name: Iasi Cubing Open 2019
information:
At the registration you can support the association "Asociatia Romana de Speedcubing" with a contribution and you will get a cubing prize.

Prizes
Certificates and medals for top 3 of each event and for the fastest girl, youngest competitor, oldest competitor and fastest competitor of Romania. Participation certificates and magnets for those competitors who register until 15.03.2019.
